description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3040014519840 SHAFT,STRAIGHT: Line 0001 Qty 519 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0092 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 77. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 20722 EJ-21281; 20722 EJ51121 ITEM NO. 9. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
